verdict.rationale: Inngest ships AgentKit and agent tool-loop patterns, so it is fair to ask whether agents built on it can connect to MCP servers. However, nothing in the pack documents Inngest or AgentKit acting as an MCP client that consumes external MCP servers' tools. The MCP evidence (docs-5, probe-4) covers only Inngest's own MCP server for coding agents, which is the server role and does not count for this story.
